title: Cloud City: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Autopilot & Enterprise Clusters
city_concept: City Container Terminal & Harbor Fleet Coordination

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Brightloaf Bakery was shipping bread using thousands of individual delivery mopeds. Drivers collided in traffic, half got lost, and keeping maintenance logs was impossible.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Mayor Meridian constructed a state-of-the-art container terminal (GKE). Standardized shipping crates (Containers) are loaded onto automated regional rail lines.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During a flash storm, a rail dock was flooded. The harbor master (GKE Scheduler) rerouted all incoming shipping crates to dry docks across town without dropping a single package.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In physical shipping, cranes take minutes to reposition; in GKE Autopilot, pods scale out in seconds with zero node management required.
